native_retrieval.title: Govt extends exemption for net metering, open access RE projects till Dec - Daily Excelsior
native_retrieval.snippet: # Govt extends exemption for net metering, open access RE projects till Dec. ## NEW DELHI, Jul 18: The Government today said it has extended the exemption timeline for net-metering and open access RE projects till December 31, 2026 under the ALMM-II. The ministry clarified that there will be no change with respect to the implementation of Approved List of Models & Manufacturers (ALMM) List-II for solar PV cells. The MNRE has decided that there will be no change in the policy of the Government of India with respect of implementation of Approved List of Models & Manufacturers (ALMM) List-II for solar PV cells, and no blanket extension in applicability of ALMM List-II for solar power projects will be provided. However, a limited window is being provided for net metering projects and open access RE power projects, whereby such projects can now commission with exemption of ALMM List-II (for solar PV cells), till 31st December 2026.

native_retrieval.snippet: Christos Tzolis arrives in north London off the back of the best season of his career, but it has taken him time to show his quality. The Greek forward struggled to make an impact during a three-year spell at Norwich City, scoring three times in 30 appearances, but rebuilt his career away from Carrow Road. After impressing on loan in the 2023-24 season at German second-tier side Fortuna Dusseldorf, where he scored 24 goals in 35 games, he left Norwich for Club Brugge and quickly established himself as one of Belgium's most productive attacking players. Last season, the 24-year-old was directly involved in a league-high 40 goals, scoring 17 times and providing 23 assists as Club Brugge were crowned league champions. Although Leandro Trossard recorded more goal involvements in last season's Champions League for Arsenal, the Greece international produced almost twice as many chances (13 compared to seven) and completed more passes in the final third (138 compared to 80).

Emergency vehicles sit outside Patrick and Lindsay Clancy's home in Duxbury, Massachusetts, in January 2023. When Patrick Clancy left his Duxbury, Massachusetts, home on January 24, 2023, he had no way of knowing a quick errand to grab takeout and medicine for his daughter would forever change his life. When he returned to the colonial on Summer Street he shared with his wife, Lindsay, and their three children, he found the house unusually quiet, he would later tell police. english_retrieval.title: South India leads India's nursing workforce as national ratio remains below WHO benchmark - The South First
english_retrieval.snippet: # South India leads India’s nursing workforce as national ratio remains below WHO benchmark. > ***Synopsis:** Parliamentary data reveal a stark regional divide in India’s nursing workforce, with Kerala, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu accounting for nearly half of the country’s registered hospital nurses. South India has emerged as the country’s nursing powerhouse, with Kerala, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu accounting for nearly half of India’s registered hospital nursing workforce and recording some of the country’s highest nurse-population ratios, according to data tabled in Parliament. A written reply by Union Health Minister JP Nadda in the Rajya Sabha on 21 July states that India had 46.02 lakh registered nursing personnel as of 31 December 2025, translating to a nurse-population ratio of 2.60 per 1,000 people. “As per the Indian Nursing Council (INC) records, there are 46.02 lakh nursing personnel registered in the country as on 31st December, 2025, giving a nurse to population ratio of 2.60 nurses per 1000 population,” Nadda said in response to a starred question.

english_retrieval.title: Former nurse behind viral LEGO propaganda videos praising Iran, mocking US - New York Post
english_retrieval.snippet: ##### US pummels Iran’s military infrastructure in latest strikes. # Former nurse behind viral LEGO propaganda videos praising Iran, mocking US. A former neonatal nurse in Wisconsin is behind the LEGO-style style videos praising Iran and depicting death against the US, The Post has learned. Mahdi Hemmat, who claims to be Iranian-American, worked until last year as a neonatal transport nurse at the Aurora Sinai Medical Center in Milwaukee, describes himself on Instagram as a “LEGO journalist … covering the information war brick by brick.”. “21 bases lit up in one night, Iran got the receipts they can’t deny,” the song played as images of Iranian bombs destroyed US military infrastructure in the region. Hemmat appears to be linked to Explosive Media — Akhbar Enfejari in Persian — a Tehran-based collective that also posts AI-generated LEGO Iranian propaganda videos ONLINE and frequently tags him in its posts. The report stated that at least 83 million people engaged with the LEGO AI propaganda videos in the first month of the Iran war.

english_retrieval.title: Trump's Tariff Revenue Turns Negative Due To Refunds - Forbes
english_retrieval.snippet: Despite facing a $25 billion negative balance in June from reimbursing $166 billion in Supreme Court-struck tariffs, the Trump administration is doubling down on trade protectionism. Now, new global duties of 10-12.5% are imposed on over 80 countries, citing forced labor under Section 301 of the Trade Act. Brazil faces a 25% tariff, and Canada a 50% duty, with more expected. The U.S. government’s customs duties receipts showed a negative balance of $25 billion in June as tariffs paid by importers under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act are being reimbursed. A total of $166 billion is to be returned, as estimated by the Tax Foundation, which is the equivalent of approximately three quarters of tariff revenue the government collected between Liberation Day in April 2025 and February 2026. Between June 2025 and the SCOTUS ruling in February, monthly tariff revenue in the U.S. had stood at between $27 billion and $31 billion per month, resulting in tariff receipts of around $195 billion for the fiscal year of 2025 ending in September.

english_retrieval.title: Agriculture Minister Gita Chaudhary Announces Model Program for 10 Municipalities - Ratopati
english_retrieval.snippet: # Agriculture Minister Gita Chaudhary Announces Model Program for 10 Municipalities. Minister for Agriculture, Forest and Environment Gita Chaudhary has stated that at least 10 municipalities will be selected as model programs and implemented, prioritizing agricultural research, technology transfer, and organic farming, to directly deliver services to the farmers' fields. Addressing a courtesy meeting with the Chief Minister of Madhesh Province, Krishna Prasad Yadav, and a high-level meeting regarding federal-provincial coordination, Minister Chaudhary said that at least 10 municipalities should be selected. She stated that there is a plan to implement a model agricultural program in those municipalities. She informed that an integrated program will be operated in at least 10 municipalities to deliver research results to the farmers' fields, increase agricultural production, and provide direct information about modern technology to the farmers. She emphasized the need to move forward through effective coordination between the federal, provincial, and local levels, proper mobilization of resources, and joint planning for the sustainable development of the agriculture, forest, and environment sectors.

english_retrieval.title: Aldebaran closes $25.96 million Centauri financing - Mining.com.au
english_retrieval.snippet: Aldebaran Resources (TSX-V:ALDE) and majority-owned subsidiary Centauri Minerals have closed a C$25.49 million ($25.96 million) subscription receipt financing ahead of Centauri’s planned spinout. The financing comprised a brokered placement of 17.49 million subscription receipts for C$17.49 million and a non-brokered placement of eight million receipts for C$8 million. Centauri plans to use the proceeds for exploration at the Rio Grande Gold–Copper Project in Argentina’s Salta province, work across its other assets, and general corporate purposes.
